decisions.statement: The reading is the mean across every account the pool has.
An account with no percent is left out of the mean rather than counted zero.
No account with a percent is no reading rather than a mean of zero.
A percent stated as text is read as the number that percent spells.
The figure is how much of the allowance is spent and the color is how long the allowance has left.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.

definition: how much of the weekly Claude allowance the pool has spent
